change: rotate() records previous_hash; presenting it within REUSE_GRACE_SECONDS=60 of rotation returns a grant with token=None (no rotation, no refresh cookie, access cookie reissued, meta.auth.rotated=false). Older or later reuse still revokes the chain.
residual_risks: A refresh response lost in transit and retried after more than 60 seconds still revokes the chain.
A stolen credential replayed inside the 60 s window after rotation is not detected (accepted by operator).
hosted_verification: Done by coordinator after deploy by reading chain states.
